bestBets.overview: FIELDS OF COURAGE made it two in a row with a strong win here last start. No reason he cannot go on and win again. GARRIX ran a slashing race when placed in the NT Derby two back then he chased the smart Biden Time home on Wednesday. This not beyond him. CAPITOL HILL was brave behind Fury here last start. Fins a similar race and he is never far away in his races. Must include in exotics. MAGARTEN has been racing in much better company that this and not measuring up. Back in right race and may surprise these.

raceTips.comment: Fields Of Courage profiles as the one to beat. Racing in career best form, drawn well and Todd sticks. He’s hard to knock. The main danger for me is Capitol Hill who returned in good order first up. If he can improve now second up and on the quick back up, he is right in this.

bestBets.overview: TEXTURE finished too well winning here last start. This looks no harder and he gets chance to make it two in a row. EASY RED demolished a maiden field here two starts back before tailing off in the NT Derby last start. Back in much easier company and the 1300m will suit better. YOUR NOT THE BOSS has just been battling in his last couple but this not difficult and he can sneak into a minor spot while ITWASONLYAKISS comes into this ready third-up from spell and last start placing suggests he is not far off a win.

raceTips.comment: Texture clearly on top. Jade Hampson and Dick Leech are striking at over 40% when combining.  Now on the quick back up, he should settle further forward of midfield and looks well placed here. Richard Bensley and Chris Nash are also striking at over 35% when combining. Easy Red should appreciate the drop back in class and distance and looks right in this off his run two starts ago.

bestBets.overview: STRUCK GOLD is the big query first-up from a break. Finished last campaign with two dominant wins and if fit enough fresh he can get away with this. COTEHELE has been disapppointing in last couple of starts but they have been in much better races than he finds here. If he produces his best form he can surprise these. ANSON BAY won by a space here two starts back then placed when favourite behind Zourata last outing. Thius a nice race for him while BRUNO BRUNO has been placed in both runs back and a win not far away.

raceTips.comment: Shisuta Bo has been racing behind some smart types. She draws best and should settle in a forward position. Now fifth up, she could be ready to peak. Struck Gold also has great form and resumes for young star trainer Ella Clark. I would want a market push but he is clearly a top winning hope.

bestBets.overview: Like the way that TEE GALLERIA has been racing but he just cannot break his maiden. Will not get a better chance than this to join winners stall. MEET ME AT THE BAR was very one paced here on Wednesday and did not finish race off. Drawn awkwardly but can improve off last run. FLASH KERMY was beaten less than a length in similar maiden here last start. Drawn perfectly and would not be surprised to see her win this while MACAVERTY showed enough at his first Darwin start last outing and he will be fitter.

raceTips.comment: Few unknowns here so happy to stay out. Flash Kermy is lightly raced and open to natural improvement. Drawn well he looks well placed here. Tee Galleria resumes but must contend with a  wide gate. Can win with luck. Natalie Joy draws well and should roll forward again. She was tough last start and just needs to hold that form.

bestBets.overview: DANIHER made it two in a row with a strong win here last start. Moving through his classes impressively and no reason he cannot go on and win again. MR MARRAKECH resumes from spell. He has only been placed in one of five first-up outings but this is not a difficult affair and would not leave out of winning chances. LUCKY FORTUNA was well held here on Wednesday but she is better than that. She can bounce back in this while THROW AT DA STUMPS was placed here last start and he will be competitive in similar race.

raceTips.comment: Lucky Fortuna looks the likely improver back in class and drawn best. I expect her to roll forward and she should be afforded very chance from there. Daniher is the danger. He comes in great form, showing an impressive turn of foot to beat home Stomp’Em who has since franked the form.

bestBets.overview: LUNA FIELD demolished a field here two starts back then started a short favourit last start but just held place in small field. He gets chance to return to winners stall. DYNAMIC THEORY won here four starts back then he has been placed in three runs since. Consistent and cannot leave out of winning chances. STARTSPANGLEDANCER has been in market in last couple but just not finishing races off well enough. Will get ideal run from inside barrier and must consider while BLACK COAL was poor last start but he may sneak into first four spot.

raceTips.comment: Luna Field was disappointing on face level as the favourite last start but was excellent two starts ago. The bigger field should suit and he loves racing here. Could definitely see an improvement. Dad Bod has been below his best of late, but too also loves to roll forward and at his best he is right in this. Dynamic Theory has been so consistent of late and should be thereabouts again.

bestBets.overview: RUNAWAY TYCOON is racing in super form. He has been dominant winning his last three starts. This is a big step up against the experienced sprinters but he can measure up. BALASTIER is racing in sound form. Won by nearly 8 lengths here last start. This is tougher but would not be surprised to see him win this. The Alice Springs dual Pioneer Sprint queen DAKOTA LEE won here two back then just missed behind Magic Defense last start. She can win while WILD BEAU made it two in a row with a soft win last start and he will be competitive again.

raceTips.comment: Hard to go past Balastier who has been so impressive since arriving in the NT. He was dominant last start when leading all the way and could yet still improve again. The knock is he draws wide and with plenty of speed on paper he will have to earn this victory the hard way, but he is tough and should be able to absorb a hot tempo and prove too good again.
